name: Abraham Lincoln
description: Follow Abraham Lincoln, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: USS Abraham Lincoln returns to San Diego after historic 10-month deployment
changes.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln docked at its homeport in the San Diego Bay on Thursday after its deployment to the Middle East nearly one year ago. CBS News' Eleanor Watson and Carter Evans report. Then, Ret. Navy Vice Adm. Robert Murrett joins with analysis.

changes.title: USS Lincoln Set to Port in San Diego After Record Deployment
changes.summary: After a record-setting and difficult deployment to the Middle East, the USS Abraham Lincoln, carrying some 5,000 service members, will finally arrive home. The aircraft carrier that was plagued by supply shortages and low morale during its nearly year-long assignment, is scheduled to dock in San Diego on Thursday, sett.

changes.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln is returning home to San Diego
changes.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln is returning home to San Diego Thursday after supporting the Iran war during a record long deployment of 265 uninterrupted days at sea that included reports of deteriorating conditions among its crew.

changes.title: Hegseth welcomes return of USS Lincoln after long, troubled deployment
changes.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier returns home to California Thursday, the Navy announced Friday, following a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war and intense scrutiny over ship conditions.

changes.title: After Months at War, Brief Solace in a Party Town Far From Home
changes.summary: A stopover in Thailand was welcome relief for thousands of troops aboard the U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln from a grueling deployment. But it was not a complete salve.

changes.title: Mother of USS Abraham Lincoln sailor "so relieved" son has arrived in Thailand
changes.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln pulled into port in Thailand for some rest and relaxation after 286 days at sea.

changes.title: See USS Abraham Lincoln Sailor Reunite With Family
changes.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln finally docked in Thailand on Wednesday, pulling into port after nearly nine months at sea. Shakira Fairfax flew from New Jersey to see her daughter Jada, one of the sailors aboard the aircraft carrier. See their first hug in nearly 300 days!

changes.title: USS Abraham Lincoln ends record stretch at sea
changes.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln ended a record stretch at sea, making its first port call in nine months. It comes amid concerns about living conditions aboard. NBC News’ Courtney Kube reports.

changes.title: The Navy’s Logistical Nightmare in the Iran War
changes.summary: Amid a crew morale crisis, the military has replaced the U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East with another aircraft carrier. Our Pentagon reporter John Ismay, a Navy veteran, explains how the challenges to supply ships in the area will most likely remain the same.

changes.title: USS Lincoln Docks After Nearly 300 Continuous Days at Sea
changes.summary: After more than 280 days at sea and reports of deteriorating conditions and morale, thousands of sailors and Marines from the USS Abraham Lincoln are finally on land. The ship arrived at a port in Eastern Thailand on Wednesday to take a four-day break from its deployment supporting the war in Iran before heading home t.
